description: A bearded man in a bronze helmet and a blue-and-gold robe sits on a carved wooden throne. He reads an unrolled scroll covered in wedge-like marks and holds an ornate key in his other hand. Behind him is a stone wall with a relief of a lion, and attendants stand at the edges, one holding a tall staff. It is a dark, oil-painted scene that runs edge to edge, with a small sparkle logo in the lower right corner.
reason: The scroll is covered in rows of wedge-shaped marks that read as cuneiform-style writing. They are not legible, but they look like painted-in script, so the artist should show a blank scroll or plain decoration instead.
